entities.summary: Institut Teknologi Telkom English: Telkom Institute of Technology (1990-2013) was an Indonesian vocational university specializing in telecommunication engineering. It was established on September 28, 1990 by the Telkom Education Foundation, which is owned by PT Telkom, the semi-privatized government-owned telecommunication company of Indonesia. The school with 480.000 m² area was in Dayeuhkolot, 3 km south of Bandung.
